gates.title: Release Coherence and Parity (F-01)
gates.requirement: Release components (frontend Vercel, backend Supabase Edge, DB migrations, worker) must be strictly coherent on exact release fingerprint. Committing final attestation must not invalidate the deployed release.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Deployed Vercel release.json, Supabase Edge Functions release_sha, and git commit SHA match identically. No self-invalidating report commits.
negative_controls: Vercel deployed SHA != Edge Function deployed SHA fails check
Uncommitted source diff fails check

gates.title: Server-Side Deterministic Pagination (F-02)
gates.requirement: observed-fares must implement genuine server-side .range(start, start + pageSize - 1) pagination with global filtering and sorting applied prior to paging.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Dataset >= 205 records: Page 1 (60), Page 2 (60), Page 3 (60), Page 4 (25), Page 5 (0). Zero ID intersection between pages; union equals exactly 205 records. Total = 205 and next_page calculated correctly.
negative_controls: Querying page 2 returns duplicates of page 1
Total count != actual matching eligible records
Client receives > pageSize records

gates.title: Canonical Travel Intent & Location Scope (F-03)
gates.requirement: TravelIntent represents originScope, destinationScope, tripType, outbound exact/window, return exact/window/length, passengers, cabin, stops, currency. LocationScope preserves EXACT_AIRPORT vs METRO vs NEARBY.
gates.acceptance_criteria: TravelIntent round-trips losslessly across UI, API, DB, Watch, Saved, and Analytics. Bangkok BKK != DMK; BKK_METRO encompasses both.
negative_controls: BKK converted to DMK without metro flag
Round-trip return date conflated with departure window end
Cabin / passengers dropped when creating Watch

gates.title: Decoupled Stable Identities
gates.requirement: Decouple TravelIntentId, OfferVariantId, ObservationId, ComparableCohortId, OpportunityId, WatchId, GenerationId. OfferVariant is based on itinerary facts, not price.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Price change creates new ObservationId but preserves OfferVariantId and OpportunityId. Transient GenerationIds never become business identities.
negative_controls: Price change creates new OfferVariantId
GenerationId stored as OpportunityId

gates.title: Authoritative Route-Best Price Truth
gates.requirement: Cheapest strictly means mathematical minimum eligible price within matching PriceScopeFingerprint. Deal Score never overrides cheaper eligible price when labeled cheapest.
gates.acceptance_criteria: 4.265M compatible fare beats 3.2M-3.8M cheaper incompatible fares (wrong cabin, return date, airport, stops). 50 shuffle order runs produce identical minimum.
negative_controls: Expensive 95-score fare beats cheaper 70-score fare
Input ordering alters chosen cheapest fare

gates.title: Global Universe Cheaper Alternative
gates.requirement: Cheaper alternative must be selected from the global compatible result universe, not an arbitrary first 30 rows in the client. Canonical URL must work and navigate correctly.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Cheaper alternative satisfies identical TravelIntent and PriceScopeFingerprint. User clicking alternative navigates to valid canonical route.
negative_controls: Candidate beyond row 30 is missed
Alternative has mismatched cabin or stops constraint

gates.title: Comparator Engine & Historical Semantics
gates.requirement: One unified Comparator Engine with strict minimum sample gating (N >= threshold). Observation timestamp must never be conflated with departure date. Insufficient data displayed as 'Chưa đủ dữ liệu', never fake median or 0%.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Price history X-axis reflects observed_at, not depart_date. Cohorts with insufficient samples display explicit accumulating evidence state.
negative_controls: October observation timestamp rendered as October travel date for December flight
N < threshold cohort displays 0% discount

gates.title: True Cost Epistemic Breakdown
gates.requirement: Explicit epistemic states: KNOWN, ESTIMATED, OPTIONAL, UNKNOWN. Unknown != 0. evaluateTrueCost actually consumes provided inputs. Missing baggage is not labeled free.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Cost summary separates known minimum, estimated extras, and unknown extras. No fixed heuristic presented as guaranteed checkout total.
negative_controls: Missing baggage fee rendered as 0₫ free
providedHiddenCosts parameter ignored

gates.title: Observed Snapshot Generation Atomicity
gates.requirement: Generations are immutable to readers. Promotion occurs only after source exhaustion/completeness. Incomplete/safety-capped builds quarantined and deleted. Reader fails closed if active pointer missing.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Missing active pointer returns status: degraded_schema. Readers query only active generation rows. Partial builds never become active.
negative_controls: Safety limit hit still promotes generation
Missing active_generation_id queries across all generations

gates.title: Provider Result Taxonomy & Route Health
gates.requirement: Provider calls return structured taxonomy (11 distinct states). Parser exceptions must never collapse to []. 0/N windows = route failure.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Parser failure or network timeout returns specific error class. Route health accurately reflects window failure rate without swallowing.
negative_controls: Exception in parser returns empty array and logs healthy
0/N windows succeed marked pipeline healthy

gates.title: Search Error vs Empty Discrimination
gates.requirement: Search distinguishes between valid empty inventory and provider 503 / network errors. UI displays truthful error recovery card with retry CTA.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Search 503 triggers retryable error state. 0 results on healthy feed displays empty state with suggestion to adjust filters.
negative_controls: Provider 503 displays 'Không tìm thấy chuyến bay nào'
Network error collapses to empty array

gates.title: Watch Monitoring Contract & Exhaustive Scan
gates.requirement: Watch preserves canonical TravelIntent. No hidden 20% discount threshold. Alert processor performs exhaustive keyset pagination over entire active generation without 5000-score cutoff.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Target price <= 5M with 5% discount matches. Eligible candidate at row 6000 is evaluated and matched.
negative_controls: Target price match suppressed by discount < 20%
Candidate beyond row 5000 ignored

gates.title: Watch Scheduler Heartbeat & Concurrency Safety
gates.requirement: Prove a real recurring evaluator exists with structured heartbeat tracking (scheduled_at, evaluated, matches, errors). Evaluator is safe against generation changes mid-scan.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Heartbeat record updated in operational monitoring. Concurrency test proves evaluation locks or pins active generation during execution.
negative_controls: Evaluator operates on deleted generation mid-scan
Execution silently terminates without recording heartbeat

gates.title: Watch Lifecycle & Condition Episodes
gates.requirement: Durable backend lifecycle (monitoring, matched, paused, degraded, sync_failed, expired). Model episodes (OUTSIDE, ENTERED, STILL_INSIDE, MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT, EXITED, REENTERED). Prevent sticky stale matched state.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Price rising above target transitions from STILL_INSIDE to EXITED. Mutations (pause/resume/delete) are remote-authoritative with rollback on failure.
negative_controls: Price above target remains marked matched forever
Local mutation succeeds while server returns 500

gates.title: Transactional Notification Outbox & Re-Alert
gates.requirement: Transactional outbox for notification intents. Idempotent delivery worker with retry backoff. Do not permanently suppress future meaningful price drops for same opportunity. Respect chosen channels.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Delivery attempts tracked with provider IDs and idempotency keys. Material price improvement triggers re-alert. User selecting Telegram does not receive unwanted email.
negative_controls: Duplicate invocation sends duplicate email
Later 30% price drop suppressed by earlier 10% alert

gates.title: Server-Authoritative Saved Opportunities
gates.requirement: For authenticated users, remote database is authoritative. Optimistic updates with rollback on network/server error. Persist rich snapshot context (TravelIntent, saved price, evidence).
gates.acceptance_criteria: Cross-device sync verifies state is restored from server. Remote error rolls back optimistic UI state.
negative_controls: Remote delete failure leaves local item permanently deleted
Saved item lacks original TravelIntent context

gates.title: Database Row-Level Security Matrix Proof
gates.requirement: Actual database tests across anon, User A, User B, and service role across SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables.
gates.acceptance_criteria: User A cannot read, update, or delete User B records. Anon cannot read internal flights, scan_runs, snapshots, or events. Service role has server-only access.
negative_controls: User A reads User B alert
Anon executes INSERT on observed_fare_snapshots

gates.title: Complete User Data Export & Deletion
gates.requirement: Schema-driven export includes all user-owned fields (departure_from, departure_to, preferences, watches, saved). Deletion RPC cascades across all user tables.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Export JSON contains complete preference fields. Account deletion removes user rows from user_alerts, user_preferences, user_bookmarks, and notifications.
negative_controls: Export omits departure_from/to
Account deletion leaves orphan active alerts

gates.title: Authentication & Session Integrity
gates.requirement: Integrated auth flows (sign in, session restore, logout, recovery) verified using Supabase auth events rather than brittle URL-only parsing.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Session restores reliably across page reload. Logout cleans private state.
negative_controls: Session restore fails on refresh
Old password remains valid after reset

gates.title: Application Security & Threat Model
gates.requirement: CSP headers, XSS prevention, open redirect prevention, booking URL validation, Turnstile abuse prevention, HMAC unsubscribe.
gates.acceptance_criteria: HTTP response contains strict CSP, frame-ancestors: none, nosniff. Booking URLs restricted to approved airline/OTA domains.
negative_controls: Unapproved booking URL hostname accepted
Turnstile verification bypassed

gates.title: Canonical Telemetry Registry & Synthetic Exclusion
gates.requirement: Canonical event registry shared across frontend, edge function, and DB. Synthetic test activity explicitly tagged and excluded from organic metrics. Savings taxonomy strictly defined.
gates.acceptance_criteria: track-event accepts canonical events and metadata. Synthetic events marked with synthetic: true. Outbound click is not labeled Confirmed Saving.
negative_controls: Synthetic E2E event recorded as organic conversion
Unknown event type accepted without validation

gates.title: Measured Performance Budgets & Web Vitals
gates.requirement: Measured lab budgets and Web Vitals instrumentation (LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1). If sample size insufficient, report FIELD_DATA_INSUFFICIENT honestly.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Bundle size within limits (< 300KB initial chunk). Real Web Vitals reporting active in browser.
negative_controls: Static PASS artifact substituted for actual measurement
Empty sample size reported as 100% compliant

gates.title: WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility & Responsive Reflow
gates.requirement: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance for core journeys: keyboard navigation, visible focus states, dialog focus trap, form labels, color contrast, and 320px reflow without horizontal overflow.
gates.acceptance_criteria: All 10 tested viewports render cleanly without horizontal scrollbars. Skip-to-content functional.
negative_controls: Horizontal overflow detected at 320px or 390px
Modal focus fails to trap or return

gates.title: Calm Analytical Instrument UX & Visual Evidence
gates.requirement: Reconstruct visual design and information architecture: light/off-white canvas, high information density, tabular numerals, clean navigation, no generic dark SaaS card soup. Actual screenshots captured across 6 viewports and independently critiqued.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Screenshots for 320, 390, 768, 1207x861, 1440, 1920 viewports demonstrate clear hierarchy, calm aesthetic, readable typography, and discernible actions.
negative_controls: App remains generic dark slate-950 card soup
Primary action clipped or hidden on mobile

gates.title: Flexible Dates, Nearby Airports & Verification Layer
gates.requirement: Flexible date matrix intelligence, metro scope airport comparison, explore by budget, and observed vs verified discrepancy tracking.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Flexible calendar marks cells as observed/fresh/stale without false availability guarantee. Verification action tracks observed-to-verified price delta.
negative_controls: Calendar displays indicative price as guaranteed live
ObservedRouteBest conflated with VerifiedRouteBest

gates.title: Multi-Dimensional Health & Observability Model
gates.requirement: Separate Platform, Discovery, Snapshot, Live Verification, Watch Processor, and Notification health. Never expose one vague HEALTHY boolean.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Health query returns distinct status for each subsystem. Structured run logs record coverage, duration, and error codes without PII.
negative_controls: Subsystem down masked by overall 'HEALTHY' badge
Raw secrets or PII logged in error traces

gates.title: Longitudinal Real-User Market Evidence
gates.requirement: Real-world organic activation, multi-month retention, confirmed booking savings, and willingness to pay. Must remain truthfully UNVERIFIED until real longitudinal evidence exists.
gates.acceptance_criteria: Status remains UNVERIFIED honestly without synthetic fabrication. Zero fake claims of PMF or booking outcome.
negative_controls: Synthetic E2E activity claimed as real user retention
Outbound click claimed as confirmed savings
gates.blocker: Requires longitudinal real-world user accumulation over weeks/months
